own_solution.law: Maxwell speed distribution tail: F = erfc(x) + (2/sqrt(pi)) x exp(-x^2), x = v/sqrt(2kT/m); amount = n F
assumptions: ideal monatomic gas in equilibrium at 300 K

defect_reasons.other: The C cancellation for pressure is constructed (n_d = p/kT multiplied in and divided out) rather than a relation the solution actually uses; pressure is better described as not entering the speed distribution at fixed n and T, but the invariance claim itself is true.

notes: Base 0.04648 mol and 317 K value 0.05404 mol match my pass-1 work; I also checked 309 K: x^2 = 3.11539, F = 0.10091, amount 0.05045 mol, matching 0.0504532. D sentences (earlier experiment, window frame) correct; minimal pairs T408F/TA78B and T4B89/TA6B3 differ only in attachment/time with same 17 K; T2124/TA645 are declared numeral-free controls. 62 kPa (and 35-150 kPa) is well inside the ideal-gas regime for helium at 300 K.
